help.records.title: How do I record a training session?
help.records.body: Open Training and choose Log session. Enter the activity, date, duration and perceived effort. Records are saved in this browser; you can link a session to a planned activity.
help.sleep.title: How do I review my sleep?
help.sleep.body: Log bedtime and wake-up time in Sleep. The monthly chart shows recorded duration and leaves missing dates blank. Device sleep stages are not available from manual entries.
help.reports.title: How do I export a PDF?
help.reports.body: Open Reports, choose a period and categories, then generate the PDF. A week of recorded history is required; an empty period cannot be exported.
help.device.title: Is my wearable connected?
help.device.body: Demo recovery and guidance use your local records with illustrative rules. Wearable metrics remain sample values. No device or external analysis service is connected.
help.preferences.title: How do notification preferences work?
help.preferences.body: Save the permitted hours and digital disconnection time in Settings. The simulation tests the saved window without sending notifications. Bedtime reminder preferences are saved in Sleep.

legal.terms.scope.title: About this version
legal.terms.scope.body: PulsePower is an educational frontend prototype for recording training, sleep and wellness. Accounts and records work locally in this browser, without a backend server. Device connections, recovery insights, community interactions and subscription changes are simulations. They do not create payments or external publications.
legal.terms.health.title: Health and responsible use
legal.terms.health.body: PulsePower does not diagnose, treat or prevent medical conditions. Guidance and recovery scores are illustrative simulations, not clinical measurements or professional medical advice. Do not use them to make medical decisions; consult a qualified health professional for health concerns. Use example data when demonstrating the prototype and do not enter another person’s information without permission.
legal.terms.ethics.title: Professional responsibility
legal.terms.ethics.body: The ACM/IEEE Software Engineering Code of Ethics and the CIP Code of Ethics guide this project: prioritize public wellbeing, be honest about limitations, respect privacy, work carefully and correct errors. These references do not imply certification or endorsement of PulsePower.
legal.privacy.data.title: Information stored
legal.privacy.data.body: Information you enter may include your name, email, profile, goals, physical history, training sessions, sleep, wellness check-ins and local preferences. Local accounts store a password verifier, not the original password. A session identifier is stored for the current browser session.
legal.privacy.storage.title: Local storage and its limits
legal.privacy.storage.body: This version stores records on your device using browser storage. It does not upload these records to a backend or synchronize them across devices. Anyone with access to this browser profile may access local information; local sign-in is not production security. Data remain until deleted or cleared by the browser. There is no server backup, and clearing browser data can remove your records.
legal.privacy.control.title: Access, correction and deletion
legal.privacy.control.body: You can review your records in the corresponding pages, update your profile in Settings and delete the selected local account and its records using the account deletion option. Other local accounts remain. Example records for the prepared demo account can be generated again. Clearing this site’s browser data removes its locally stored accounts, records and preferences; downloaded reports must be deleted separately.
